#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MD = 998244353;
vector<long long> ww, ww_;

long long power(long long a, int k) {
    if (k == 0) return 1;
    long long p = power(a, k / 2);
    p = p * p % MD;
    if (k % 2 == 1) p = p * a % MD;
    return p;
}

void init() {
    ww.resize(21);
    ww_.resize(21);
    for (int h = 0; h <= 20; h++) {
        ww[h] = power(3, (MD - 1) >> h);
        ww_[h] = power(3, (MD - 1) - ((MD - 1) >> h));
    }
}

void ntt(vector<long long>& aa, int n, bool inverse) {
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int b = n;
        do {
            j ^= b >>= 1;
        } while ((j & b) == 0);
        if (i < j) {
            swap(aa[i], aa[j]);
        }
    }
    for (int h = 0; (1 << h) < n; h++) {
        long long w_ = inverse ? ww_[h + 1] : ww_[h + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += (1 << (h + 1))) {
            long long w = 1;
            int b = 1 << h;
            for (int j = 0; j < b; j++) {
                int l = i + j, r = l + b;
                long long u = aa[l], v = aa[r] * w % MD;
                aa[l] = (u + v) % MD;
                aa[r] = (u - v + MD) % MD;
                w = w * w_ % MD;
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    init();
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    n /= 2;
    int n_ = 1;
    while (n_ < n * 9 + 1) n_ <<= 1;
    vector<long long> aa(n_);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int d;
        cin >> d;
        aa[d] = 1;
    }
    ntt(aa, n_, false);
    for (int i = 0; i < n_; i++) {
        aa[i] = power(aa[i], n);
    }
    ntt(aa, n_, true);
    long long v = power(n_, MD - 2);
    for (int i = 0; i < n_; i++) {
        aa[i] = aa[i] * v % MD;
    }
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n * 9; i++) {
        long long a = aa[i];
        ans = (ans + a * a) % MD;
    }
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
